context.objective: Perform a minimalist, read-only code audit of the website to identify and suggest removal of unused, redundant, or unnecessary code (bloat).

instructions.instruction_1: READ ONLY ENFORCEMENT: Do NOT modify any files. Do NOT delete anything. Do NOT execute destructive commands.
instructions.instruction_2: Analyze the codebase to find dead code, unused components, unnecessary imports, and bloated logic.
instructions.instruction_3: Focus on maintaining the EXACT current functionality of the web app. Nothing must break.
instructions.instruction_4: Return a detailed summary of the findings, including which files contain unnecessary code, what lines or blocks to remove, and why.
instructions.instruction_5: Format the output as a clean markdown report.
